@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+# Private-code delivery
+
+Use [`examples/px1-review-private.yml`](../examples/px1-review-private.yml) for
+repositories whose source should not be published through a public GitHub Pages
+site. The workflow uploads the static bundle as a GitHub Actions artifact and
+links it from the pull request.
+
+The download requires a signed-in GitHub user with read access to the repository,
+as described in GitHub's [artifact download documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/download-workflow-artifacts).
+The example retains each artifact for 30 days. After downloading and unzipping
+the artifact, open `index.html`; it makes no network requests.
+
+## Privacy check
+
+The reusable Action runs `px1 privacy-check` by default. It blocks delivery when
+the generated report contains a high-confidence secret signature or a changed
+path commonly used for credentials, such as `.env`, a private key, or a package
+manager credentials file. Findings name the signature or path but never print
+the detected value.
+
+This bounded check can miss secrets and can produce false positives. It does not
+remove content, redact values, or grant access control. Fix or remove sensitive
+material before delivery. `privacy-check: false` exists for reviewed false
+positives and emits a warning; it must not be treated as a safe-publication flag.
+
+## Model transfer
+
+AI explanations are off unless `explanation-model` is set. Enabling them sends
+bounded, non-excluded pull-request diff content to the configured model endpoint.
+The Action warns before transfer. `explanation-exclude-globs` reduces the paths
+sent to the model, but it is not redaction and excluded files still appear in
+the report bundle.
+
+## Integrity
+
+Every bundle contains `checksums.sha256` for `index.html` and `review.json`.
+GitHub's uploaded archive also has an artifact digest shown in the private
+workflow's PR comment. These hashes can detect changed bytes; they do not prove
+who generated or approved the report.
+
+## Public Pages
+
+The Pages template remains available for repositories that deliberately choose
+that delivery model. Confirm the site's effective visibility before enabling it:
+a private source repository does not by itself guarantee a private Pages site.
+GitHub documents the applicable [Pages visibility and access-control behavior](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/changing-the-visibility-of-your-github-pages-site).

The download requires a signed-in GitHub user with read access to the repository,
The example retains each artifact for 30 days. After downloading and unzipping
the artifact, open `index.html`; it makes no network requests.
The reusable Action runs `px1 privacy-check` by default. It blocks delivery when
the generated report contains a high-confidence secret signature or a changed
path commonly used for credentials, such as `.env`, a private key, or a package
manager credentials file. Findings name the signature or path but never print
This bounded check can miss secrets and can produce false positives. It does not
remove content, redact values, or grant access control. Fix or remove sensitive
material before delivery. `privacy-check: false` exists for reviewed false
positives and emits a warning; it must not be treated as a safe-publication flag.
AI explanations are off unless `explanation-model` is set. Enabling them sends
bounded, non-excluded pull-request diff content to the configured model endpoint.
The Action warns before transfer. `explanation-exclude-globs` reduces the paths
sent to the model, but it is not redaction and excluded files still appear in
GitHub's uploaded archive also has an artifact digest shown in the private
workflow's PR comment. These hashes can detect changed bytes; they do not prove
who generated or approved the report.
The Pages template remains available for repositories that deliberately choose
that delivery model. Confirm the site's effective visibility before enabling it:
a private source repository does not by itself guarantee a private Pages site.

GitHub documents the applicable [Pages visibility and access-control behavior](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/changing-the-visibility-of-your-github-pages-site).

@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+name: px1 private review artifact
+
+# ACCESS-CONTROLLED DELIVERY TEMPLATE: reports are uploaded as authenticated
+# GitHub Actions artifacts instead of being published through GitHub Pages.
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  checks: read
+  pull-requests: write
+
+concurrency:
+  group: px1-private-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  review:
+    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    env:
+      BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+      HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+      REPORT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/px1-review
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout trusted base
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Fetch PR head as data
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git fetch --no-tags origin \
+            "refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/head:refs/remotes/origin/px1-pr-head"
+          test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/px1-pr-head)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
+
+      - name: Collect exact-head GitHub checks
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        env:
+          VERIFICATION_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.px1/verification.json
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const fs = require('fs');
+            const runs = await github.paginate(github.rest.checks.listForRef, {
+              owner: context.repo.owner,
+              repo: context.repo.repo,
+              ref: process.env.HEAD_SHA,
+              per_page: 100,
+            });
+            const names = new Map();
+            const checks = runs.map((run) => {
+              const baseName = run.name || run.app?.name || 'GitHub check';
+              const count = (names.get(baseName) || 0) + 1;
+              names.set(baseName, count);
+              const name = count === 1 ? baseName : `${baseName} (${count})`;
+              let status = 'cancelled';
+              if (run.status === 'queued') status = 'queued';
+              else if (run.status !== 'completed') status = 'running';
+              else if (run.conclusion === 'success' || run.conclusion === 'neutral') status = 'passed';
+              else if (['failure', 'timed_out', 'action_required'].includes(run.conclusion)) status = 'failed';
+              return {
+                name,
+                status,
+                summary: run.output?.summary || '',
+                url: run.html_url || '',
+                startedAt: run.started_at || undefined,
+                finishedAt: run.completed_at || undefined,
+              };
+            });
+            fs.mkdirSync('.px1', { recursive: true });
+            fs.writeFileSync(process.env.VERIFICATION_FILE, `${JSON.stringify({
+              source: 'github-actions',
+              revision: process.env.HEAD_SHA,
+              url: `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
+              checks,
+            }, null, 2)}\n`);
+
+      - name: Generate commit-pinned report
+        uses: kedarvartak/px1@v1
+        with:
+          base: ${{ env.BASE_SHA }}
+          head: ${{ env.HEAD_SHA }}
+          root: ${{ github.workspace }}
+          verification-file: ${{ github.workspace }}/.px1/verification.json
+          privacy-check: true
+          out: ${{ env.REPORT_DIR }}
+
+      # Enabling explanation-model also requires OPENAI_API_KEY in env and sends
+      # bounded, non-excluded diff content to that model provider. Exclusion
+      # globs reduce input scope but are not redaction.
+
+      - name: Upload access-controlled review
+        id: upload
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: px1-review-${{ env.HEAD_SHA }}
+          path: ${{ env.REPORT_DIR }}
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30
+
+      - name: Update sticky PR comment
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        env:
+          ARTIFACT_URL: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-url }}
+          ARTIFACT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-digest }}
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const marker = '<!-- px1-static-review -->';
+            const body = [
+              marker,
+              '## px1 private review artifact',
+              '',
+              `Review for commit \`${process.env.HEAD_SHA}\`.`,
+              '',
+              `[Download the authenticated report artifact](${process.env.ARTIFACT_URL})`,
+              '',
+              'Download, unzip, and open `index.html`. Repository read access is required and the artifact expires after 30 days.',
+              '',
+              `Archive SHA-256: \`${process.env.ARTIFACT_DIGEST}\``,
+              '',
+              '_Checksums detect changes; they do not prove authorship. Privacy scanning is not redaction or access control._',
+            ].join('\n');
+            const params = {
+              owner: context.repo.owner,
+              repo: context.repo.repo,
+              issue_number: context.issue.number,
+              per_page: 100,
+            };
+            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments, params);
+            const existing = comments.find((comment) =>
+              comment.user?.type === 'Bot' && comment.body?.includes(marker));
+            if (existing) {
+              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
+                owner: params.owner,
+                repo: params.repo,
+                comment_id: existing.id,
+                body,
+              });
+            } else {
+              await github.rest.issues.createComment({ ...params, body });
+            }

explanations.title: Accepts the legacy API secret name
explanations.summary: The report workflow still prefers `OPENAI_API_KEY`, but now also accepts the legacy `OPENAI_API__KEY` secret, allowing model-backed reports to run during a secret-name transition.

explanations.title: Makes privacy scanning the default
explanations.summary: The reusable Action now enables the privacy check by default, so a report that triggers the check will stop before delivery unless the check is explicitly disabled.

explanations.title: Warns before sending diff content to a model
explanations.summary: When model explanations are enabled, the workflow now warns that bounded, non-excluded pull-request diff content will be sent to the configured endpoint.

explanations.title: Adds access-controlled report delivery
explanations.summary: The new private workflow uploads the report as a GitHub Actions artifact instead of publishing it through Pages. Its PR comment links to the download, which requires repository read access and expires after 30 days.

explanations.title: Adds checksums to each report bundle
explanations.summary: Generated bundles now include a SHA-256 manifest covering `index.html` and `review.json`, giving recipients a way to detect changed files.

explanations.title: Blocks selected sensitive report content
explanations.summary: The check blocks reports containing selected credential-path names or signatures for common secrets. It reports the type or path, not the detected secret value; it is detection, not redaction.

explanations.title: Validates checksums in report history
explanations.summary: The history script checks each report's checksum manifest when validating a site, and validates restored history before use. A report with invalid checksums is rejected.

explanations.title: Exposes checksum information in the report
explanations.summary: The report footer now links to the checksum manifest and clarifies that checksums detect file changes but do not establish who generated or approved the report.

evidence.label: Human review progress
evidence.detail: Your file marks and acknowledgements are local declarations for this comparison, not approval or proof of correctness.
limits: Progress is stored only in this browser and is not shared with GitHub.

evidence.label: Deterministic analysis
evidence.detail: Rules, attention signals, affected-file hints, and inspection questions were computed from this exact comparison. Zero findings means no matches, not that the change is safe.

evidence.label: AI explanations
evidence.detail: 8 optional AI explanations attached for the exact report head; they may be incomplete or wrong.

evidence.label: CI verification
evidence.detail: 2 recorded GitHub Actions checks; this is not a live status feed.
